intro_zh: 演示里的句子不是背模板，而是带着听众走：先告诉他们看哪里，再指出关键数字，最后给结论。下面这些说法各有固定的位置——开场、翻页、切到细节、收尾——用对位置比用对语法更重要。
intro_en: The spoken moves that carry an audience through a chart.

expressions.head: Let me draw your attention to ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 请大家注意看……（讲到一半时，把听众的视线引到图上某个具体位置）
expressions.pattern: Let me draw your attention to + noun / to the + part of the chart
collocations: draw your attention to the chart
draw your attention to the top line

examples.en: Let me draw your attention to the gap between East and West in the final quarter.
examples.zh: 请大家注意最后一个季度东部和西部之间的差距。

expressions.contrast_zh: 用在演示中途，把视线引到图上某个具体位置；开场第一句更自然的是 As you can see from this chart。比 Look at 更礼貌、更正式。

expressions.head: As you can see from this chart, ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 从这张图可以看到……（开场或翻到新一页时）
expressions.pattern: As you can see from this chart, + clause
collocations: as you can see from the chart

examples.en: As you can see from this chart, revenue is just above target, but profit is below.
examples.zh: 从这张图可以看到，收入略高于目标，但利润低于目标。

expressions.contrast_zh: 开场或翻页时用，前提是听众正看着同一张图；正式书面报告里换成 As the chart shows。听众看不到图时不要用这句。

expressions.head: I'd like to highlight ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 我想重点强调……（告诉听众这个点最重要）
expressions.pattern: I'd like to highlight + noun / the fact that + clause

examples.en: I'd like to highlight one number: 760 of 10,000 visitors actually buy.
examples.zh: 我想强调一个数字：一万名访客里只有 760 人真正购买。

expressions.contrast_zh: 主动告诉听众“这个最重要”，后面通常只跟一个点；What stands out is 更客观，让数据自己说话。一页里用一次就够，连续用会显得每个点都重要。

expressions.head: Looking at the figures, ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 看具体数字的话……（从整体转到念数字）
expressions.pattern: Looking at the figures, + clause / Looking at the figures for + noun

examples.en: Looking at the figures, Spain drew 85 million arrivals, just behind France at 100.
examples.zh: 看具体数字，西班牙入境游客为 8,500 万人次，仅次于法国的 1 亿人次。

expressions.contrast_zh: 从讲整体转到念具体数字时的过渡；后面接一两个关键数字就够，不要把所有数念完。比 According to the figures 自然，口语里也常用。

expressions.head: The key takeaway here is ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 这里最关键的一点是……（一页讲完时收结论）
expressions.pattern: The key takeaway here is + noun / that + clause

examples.en: The key takeaway here is that every region grew, but West grew fastest.
examples.zh: 这里最关键的一点是：每个地区都在增长，但西部增长最快。

expressions.contrast_zh: 放在一页图讲完时，把结论压成一句；和 What stands out is 相比，它更像你的判断，可以直接接行动建议。一页最多一句。

expressions.head: What stands out is ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 最突出的是……（演示中强调一个点）
expressions.pattern: What stands out is + noun / how + adjective + clause

examples.en: What stands out is how few visitors reach the purchase stage: 760 out of 10,000.
examples.zh: 最突出的是走到购买这一步的人少得可怜：一万名访客里只有 760 人。

expressions.contrast_zh: 不带“我”的主观色彩，让图自己说话，后面常接 how + 形容词；I'd like to highlight 更主动、更正式。overall 分类里也有类似说法，那里用于概括，这里用于演示中强调一个点。

expressions.head: Moving on to ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 接下来看……（换到下一页或下一个话题）
collocations: moving on to the next slide
moving on to the second point

examples.en: Moving on to the next quarter, West sales reached 326.
examples.zh: 接下来看下一个季度，西部销售额达到 326。

expressions.contrast_zh: 提示听众换页或换话题，一句话就够；正式一点说 Let's move on to。它只负责过渡，不要把新结论塞在过渡句里。

expressions.head: If we look more closely at ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 如果仔细看……（从大图切到细节）
expressions.pattern: If we look more closely at + noun, + clause
collocations: look more closely at the data

examples.en: If we look more closely at the funnel, the biggest drop comes between product view and cart.
examples.zh: 如果仔细看漏斗，最大的流失出现在商品浏览和购物车之间。

expressions.contrast_zh: 从整体切到细节或解释异常时用；后面必须真的给出细节，不能只说“仔细看”就停。口语里也可以说 take a closer look at。

expressions.head: Compared with the previous quarter, ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 和上一季度相比……（明确比较基准）
expressions.pattern: Compared with the previous quarter, + clause

examples.en: Compared with the previous quarter, East sales rose from 632 to 690.
examples.zh: 和上一季度相比，东部销售额从 632 上升到 690。

expressions.contrast_zh: 明确告诉听众比较基准，避免误以为是同比；正式报告用 compared with，口语常用 compared to。对应的年度比较是 year on year。

expressions.head: To put this in context, ...
expressions.meaning_zh: 把这个数字放到背景里看……（给出参照）
expressions.pattern: To put this in context, + clause

examples.en: To put this in context, 760 buyers out of 10,000 visitors is under one in ten.
examples.zh: 把这个数字放到背景里看：一万名访客里 760 人购买，不到十分之一。

expressions.contrast_zh: 给出一个数字后补一句参照，让听众知道它算大还是小；常和百分比、前后对比一起用。不要用它引出与数字无关的故事。
